user.title: Select Service

menu_options.safety_alert: Safety Alert (Ministry of the Interior and Safety)
menu_options.disaster: Disaster Information (National Disaster and Safety Portal)

user.description: Choose the Korean service to add. Each service is configured independently.

kepco.title: KEPCO Login
kepco.description: Sign in with the account used on the KEPCO Power Planner website to retrieve electricity usage and billing data.

data_description.username: Your KEPCO Power Planner login ID.

gasapp.title: GasApp Configuration
gasapp.description: Enter the account values from an authenticated GasApp session to retrieve gas usage and billing data.

data_description.token: The X-Token value from an authenticated GasApp API session.
data_description.member_id: The X-Member value identifying the GasApp member.
data_description.company_id: The X-Company value for the gas company associated with the contract.
data_description.use_contract_num: The gas use-contract number associated with the account.

safety_alert.title: Safety Alert Setup - Select Province/City
safety_alert.description: Select the province or metropolitan city whose safety alerts you want to receive.

data_description.sido_code: The province or metropolitan city used to filter safety alerts.

safety_alert_sgg.title: Safety Alert Setup - Select District
safety_alert_sgg.description: Select a district in {sido_name}. If the district list cannot be loaded, enter its name manually.

data_description.sgg_code: A district returned by the Safety Alert region service.
data_description.sgg_name: The district name to use when the region list is unavailable.

safety_alert_emd.title: Safety Alert Setup - Select Sub-district
safety_alert_emd.description: Select a sub-district in {sgg_name}. If the sub-district list cannot be loaded, enter its name manually.

data_description.emd_code: A sub-district returned by the Safety Alert region service.
data_description.emd_name: The sub-district name to use when the region list is unavailable.

goodsflow.title: GoodsFlow Configuration
goodsflow.description: Enter the GoodsFlow authentication token used by the parcel-tracking website.

data_description.token: The PTK-TOKEN value from an authenticated GoodsFlow browser session.

cj_one_delivery.title: CJ O-NE Delivery Tracking
cj_one_delivery.description: Enter a mobile phone number to receive a CJ O-NE SMS verification code.

data_description.phone_number: A 10- or 11-digit Korean mobile number. Hyphens are allowed.

cj_one_delivery_code.title: CJ O-NE Phone Verification
cj_one_delivery_code.description: Enter the verification code sent by SMS. The code may expire after a short time.

data_description.auth_code: The numeric code received in the CJ O-NE verification SMS.

cj_one_delivery_options.title: CJ O-NE Delivery Options
cj_one_delivery_options.description: Choose how often CJ O-NE delivery information is refreshed. Each active or recently completed parcel is represented by a sensor.

arisu.title: Arisu Configuration
arisu.description: Enter the customer details printed on your Seoul Arisu water bill.

data_description.customer_number: The customer number printed on the water bill.
data_description.customer_name: The customer name exactly as printed on the water bill.

kakaomap.title: KakaoMap Configuration
kakaomap.description: Define a named route by entering its start and destination coordinates. Coordinates are validated before the entry is created.

data_description.name: A recognizable name for this route, such as Home to Work.
data_description.api_key: The REST API key from your Kakao Developers application.
data_description.web_cookie: Cookie header copied from an anonymous map.kakao.com request. Use this when no REST API key is configured.
data_description.start_id: Optional KakaoMap place or station ID used by the web route API.
data_description.end_id: Optional KakaoMap place or station ID used by the web route API.
data_description.coord_system: WGS84 uses longitude and latitude; WCONGNAMUL uses KakaoMap X and Y coordinates.
data_description.start_x: Starting longitude for WGS84 or X coordinate for WCONGNAMUL.
data_description.start_y: Starting latitude for WGS84 or Y coordinate for WCONGNAMUL.
data_description.end_x: Destination longitude for WGS84 or X coordinate for WCONGNAMUL.
data_description.end_y: Destination latitude for WGS84 or Y coordinate for WCONGNAMUL.

weather_warning.title: Weather Warning
weather_warning.description: Configure KMA weather warnings using a Public Data Portal service key and one or more warning areas.

data_description.api_key: The service key issued for the KMA weather-warning API on the Public Data Portal.
data_description.area_codes: One or more regions whose warnings should be monitored.

transit.title: Transit Keys
transit.description: Enter the API keys used by the transit sources you plan to configure. Keys for unused sources may be left empty.

data_description.seoul_api_key: Optional key from the Seoul Open Data Plaza for Seoul subway arrivals.
data_description.bus_api_key: Optional public bus API key for bus arrival data.

transit_add.title: Add
transit_add.description: Add subway stations or bus stops to monitor. Choose Done after adding all desired transit items.

transit_subway.title: Subway
transit_subway.description: Configure a subway station, travel direction, and optional line filter.

data_description.station: Station name without the word “Station”, for example Gangnam.
data_description.direction: The direction of travel to monitor.
data_description.line_id: Optional subway line filter; leave empty to include all lines.

transit_bus_search.title: Add Bus Stop
transit_bus_search.description: Find a bus stop using the stop ID shown by KakaoMap.

data_description.kakao_stop_id: The KakaoMap bus-stop identifier, such as BS12345.

transit_bus_select.title: Select Bus Routes
transit_bus_select.description: Select the bus routes to monitor at this stop.

data_description.buses: One or more routes serving this stop. All detected routes are selected by default.

fuel.title: Fuel
fuel.description: Configure nearby fuel-price monitoring by selecting regions and fuel types supported by Opinet.

data_description.api_key: The API key issued by Opinet.
data_description.sido_codes: One or more provinces or metropolitan cities to monitor.
data_description.fuel_codes: One or more fuel types to monitor in each selected region.

school.title: School
school.description: Start school setup with a NEIS API key and the school level to search.

data_description.api_key: The API key issued for the NEIS Open API.
data_description.school_level: The school level determines the available grades and timetable endpoint.

school_search.title: Search
school_search.description: Search by school name, then select the correct school from the returned results.

data_description.school_search: Enter enough of the school name to distinguish it from similarly named schools.
data_description.selected_school: Select the school that matches the desired name and address.

school_class.title: Select Grade/Class
school_class.description: Select every grade and class whose timetable should be monitored.

data_description.grade_classes: Select one or more grade-class combinations.

school_periods.title: Periods
school_periods.description: Set the time range for each class period and the lunch break. Use 24-hour HH:MM-HH:MM format for periods.

data_description.period_1: Start and end time for period 1, in HH:MM-HH:MM format.
data_description.period_2: Start and end time for period 2, in HH:MM-HH:MM format.
data_description.period_3: Start and end time for period 3, in HH:MM-HH:MM format.
data_description.period_4: Start and end time for period 4, in HH:MM-HH:MM format.
data_description.period_5: Start and end time for period 5, in HH:MM-HH:MM format.
data_description.period_6: Start and end time for period 6, in HH:MM-HH:MM format.
data_description.period_7: Start and end time for period 7, in HH:MM-HH:MM format.
data_description.lunch_start: Lunch break start time in HH:MM format.
data_description.lunch_end: Lunch break end time in HH:MM format.

disaster.title: Disaster
disaster.description: Configure national disaster messages with an optional region filter.

data_description.api_key: The service key issued for the National Disaster and Safety Portal API.
data_description.region_filter: Optional province-level filter. Select All to receive messages nationwide.
data_description.sub_region: Optional city, district, or other text filter. This takes priority over the region selection.

pharmacy.title: Pharmacy
pharmacy.description: Configure pharmacy information for a province and an optional city or district.

data_description.api_key: The service key issued for the pharmacy-information API on the Public Data Portal.
data_description.q0: Province or metropolitan city to search.
data_description.q1: Optional city or district name used to narrow the results.

airkorea.title: AirKorea - Province
airkorea.description: Configure air-quality monitoring for a province or metropolitan city.

data_description.api_key: The service key issued for AirKorea APIs on the Public Data Portal.
data_description.sido: Province or metropolitan city containing the monitoring stations.
data_description.living_api_key: Optional separate key for living-weather indices. Leave empty to reuse the AirKorea key.

airkorea_select.title: Select Stations
airkorea_select.description: Select one or more AirKorea monitoring stations to create sensors for.

data_description.stations: Monitoring stations whose air-quality values should be exposed as sensors.

kma_weather.title: KMA Weather - Province
kma_weather.description: Choose a province or metropolitan city before selecting detailed forecast regions.

data_description.api_key: The service key issued for the KMA village-forecast API on the Public Data Portal.
data_description.sido: Province or metropolitan city containing the forecast districts.

kma_weather_sgg.title: Select Districts
kma_weather_sgg.description: Select forecast districts and, optionally, an AirKorea station for ozone and UV-related information.

data_description.regions: One or more districts to create weather entities for.
data_description.air_station: Optional station used for ozone and UV-related values; select Disabled if not needed.

earthquake.title: Earthquake
earthquake.description: Configure earthquake monitoring around a reference location and minimum magnitude.

data_description.api_key: The service key issued for the KMA earthquake API on the Public Data Portal.
data_description.radius_km: Maximum distance from the reference location, in kilometers.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the server. ({error})
error.no_sgg_available: No districts are available for the selected province or city.
error.no_emd_available: No sub-districts are available for the selected district.
error.no_stops_found: Could not find the bus stop.
error.no_stations_found: Could not find monitoring station information.
error.invalid_phone_number: Enter a valid 10- or 11-digit mobile phone number.
error.invalid_verification_code: The verification code is invalid or expired. ({error})

abort.already_configured: This account or service is already configured.
abort.invalid_auth: The verification session expired. Start setup again.

init.title: Options
init.description: Edit the settings available for this service. Only fields supported by the selected service are shown.

data_description.api_key: Public Data Portal service key used for weather-warning requests.
data_description.area_codes: Regions whose weather warnings should be monitored.
data_description.scan_interval_minutes: CJ O-NE refresh interval from 3 to 30 minutes.

kakaomap.title: KakaoMap Options
kakaomap.description: Enter either a REST API key or an anonymous KakaoMap web cookie.

data_description.api_key: The REST API key from your Kakao Developers application.
data_description.web_cookie: Cookie header copied from a map.kakao.com route request. The captcha token is generated automatically.

abort.no_options_earthquake: There are no options to configure for earthquake information.

abort.no_options_kakaomap: There are no options to configure for KakaoMap.
